payload.core_mechanism_summary: BFS computes leaf distance parity; minF=1 if all leaves have same parity else 3. maxF uses edge count minus forced equalities from leaf siblings.
payload.rationale: Minimizing f uses a greedy determination of the smallest feasible distinct weights via a parity feasibility check. Maximizing f counts the maximum distinct edges possible under XOR constraints, greedily assigning distinct weights where allowed.
